goal: Scaffold the project and build the Liquid Glass material system, desktop, transparent menu bar with Apple + dynamic per-app menus and focus tracking, Dock, window manager, and theming — proven end-to-end with one stub app.
summary:
Phase 1 (Foundation & Liquid Glass Shell) complete — all 6 steps done, plus all three grader recommendations from the B-grade review addressed.

Built end-to-end:
- **Scaffold** (Step 1): Vite 8 + React 19 + TS 6 + Tailwind v4 + Framer Motion 13 + oxlint; `@/` path aliases; folder structure.
- **Liquid Glass material system** (Step 2): `GlassSurface` component (backdrop-filter blur/saturate + translucent layers + specular highlights + sheen), `theme.css` with light/dark/accent CSS variables, `ThemeProvider` setting data-theme/data-accent/.reduce-transparency on <html>. Reduce Transparency flattens all glass to near-opaque.
- **Desktop + menu bar** (Step 3): full-screen wallpaper, transparent Liquid Glass menu bar (Apple logo + focused-app name + per-app menus + status glyphs + live clock), full menu data model, dropdown+submenu renderer with hover-switch + click-outside/Escape, working Apple menu (About/System Settings/Sleep/Restart/Shut Down/Lock).
- **Window manager** (Step 4): draggable title bar, traffic-light buttons, 8 resize handles, maximize/minimize/restore, z-order focus → menu bar re-titles.
- **Dock** (Step 5): Liquid Glass capsule, Framer Motion magnification, click-to-launch, running indicator dots, all 14 apps in the registry.
- **Theming** (Step 6): `ThemePanel` (dark-mode toggle, 7-accent picker, Reduce Transparency toggle) wired to the menu bar's Control Center icon.

Grader recommendations addressed (this retry):
1. **Impure setWindows updaters fixed** (windows-store.tsx): `focusWindow` and `closeWindow` now read current state from a `windowsRef` mirror and call all side effects (`os.setActiveAppId`, `setFocusedId`, `zCounter++`) OUTSIDE the `setWindows` updater. The updater is now a pure map/filter — safe under StrictMode's double-invocation.
2. **App registration moved out of useMemo** (App.tsx): extracted to module-level `src/lib/app-registration.ts` (`registerAllApps()` called on import, idempotent via a `registered` flag; Finder menus extracted to `finderMenus()`). No side-effects-in-render.
3. **Runtime test added** (vitest + Testing Library + jsdom): `src/test/focus-menu-bar.test.tsx` renders the full `<App/>`, asserts the menu bar shows "Finder" on boot (data-testid="active-app-name"), clicks the Calculator Dock icon (aria-label="Launch Calculator"), and asserts the menu bar re-titles to "Calculator" — proving the focus→menu-bar wiring at runtime, not just by compilation.

Verification (all pass):
- `pnpm build` → exit 0; tsc clean; 441 modules (348.78 kB JS / 11.44 kB CSS).
- `pnpm exec oxlint` → 0 warnings, 0 errors (30 files).
- `pnpm exec vitest run` → 1 test passed (focus→menu-bar wiring).
- `pnpm dev` → boots on http://localhost:5173 in ~140ms.

The shell is a functional macOS Tahoe foundation: desktop, transparent menu bar with working Apple + per-app menus, draggable/resizable windows, Liquid Glass Dock with magnification, and live theming — with a runtime test proving the focus→menu-bar pipeline. Phase 2 builds the 5 OS overlays; Phase 3 fills in the 14 apps' real content.

  4. Window manager: draggable/resizable/min/max/close windows, z-order focus, and focus→menu-bar app-name + menus update. [verified]
  5. Liquid Glass Dock with Framer Motion magnification; an app registry; one stub app opens from the Dock. [verified]
  6. Theming: light/dark + accent-color tints via CSS vars app-wide; Reduce Transparency toggle flattens effects. Manual: toggle dark mode and observe Dock/menus re-tint. [verified]
